346.DSCR:
A member of the secret organization $$アマルガム$$.
A twisted pervert with warped tastes and personality. His emotions swing wildly, and he casually takes human lives while making cheerful remarks; his words and actions are eccentric and full of danger. At the same time, he also possesses a soldier's sharp insight and intellect, able to accurately analyze a battle from an aerial view of its aftermath alone.
He is also highly skilled at piloting an AS, to the point that $$ガウルン$$ calls him a 'master hand'. His unit is the $$プラン１０５６　コダールｉ$$. He wields the Lambda Driver with ease, repeatedly driving $$宗介$$ and $$ミスリル$$ into desperate situations, but in Hong Kong he was defeated by a $$宗介$$ who had cast off his hesitation.
Incidentally, he is particular about his sideburns, and has claimed that their length is a matter of life and death.

347.DSCR:
Leader of the terrorist group $$Ａ２１$$.
Out of loyalty and a desire for revenge for $$タケチ・セイジ$$, whom she looked up to like a father, she plots a terrorist attack in Tokyo together with her former comrades.
She acts as a cold, calculating commander in pursuit of her goal, using $$タクマ$$ - who believes her to be his older sister - to pilot $$ベヘモス$$.
Yet in her conversation with the captive $$カリーニン$$, she also reveals a more human side.
Though she succeeds in activating $$ベヘモス$$, she is wounded, and in the end is watched over in her final moments by her enemy, $$カリーニン$$.

348.DSCR:
A high school girl attending $$陣代高校$$. Age 16.
She is the class representative of Class 2-4 and also serves as vice president of the student council. Blessed with outstanding athletic ability, she is called in as a last-minute reinforcement whenever matches for the various sports clubs draw near.
She has a straightforward personality with no hidden agenda, is caring, and full of energy. She holds the unwelcome title of 'Idol I'd least want as a girlfriend,' yet she is a popular figure trusted by boys and girls alike.
She finds herself swept up by the strange behavior of the transfer student $$宗介$$, and this encounter comes to greatly change the course of her fate.
Though she herself was unaware of it, she is one of the so-called '$$ウィスパード$$,' who possess knowledge of 'Black Technology,' a science that supposedly does not exist, and $$宗介$$ was an agent dispatched to guard her from organizations targeting that power.
From then on, she and $$宗介$$ fight against a variety of enemies, $$ガウルン$$ chief among them, and in the process grow closer in heart.

Even when $$宗介$$ causes an uproar, such as blowing up the shoe lockers, he wields considerable political skill, saying things like 'I will have a word with the faculty myself,' and does not yield an inch to the faculty in the name of student self-governance.
Incidentally, he gets along well with $$宗介$$, and appoints him as his aide for security affairs, assistant to the student council president.

357.DSCR:
The caretaker at $$陣代高校$$.
He has a mild-mannered personality, but seems to have grown somewhat disillusioned with the youth of today.

358.DSCR:
Belongs to the assault mecha company at the Japan Ground Self-Defense Force's $$練馬$$ base. His rank is master sergeant.
He is the captain of the $$練馬レッドドラゴン$$, the AS unit that is $$練馬$$ base's pride. His skill at piloting an AS is such that even $$宗介$$ acknowledges it, and $$練馬$$ has come out on top every year in its AS competition matches against $$習志野$$ base.
However, he has a highly narcissistic personality, and persistently hits on $$かなめ$$.
At the AS competition held during $$習志野$$ base's open festival, he invites $$かなめ$$ to join him in a mock cavalry battle. He deploys an unconventional formation attack that gives $$習志野$$'s assault mecha company a hard time, but in the end, thanks to the efforts of the $$風間$$ father and son, he is defeated by the $$習志野$$ team.

363.DSCR:
A member of $$チームＤ$$ and the pilot of the $$ノヴァライノス$$. The reading of his given name is '$$サクヤ$$'.
His catchphrase is 'I'll make it happen.'
Wanting to be alone and not wanting to be tied down by a cell phone or anything else, he had been living homeless, sleeping in a cardboard box in a park.
While enjoying his freedom to the fullest, he is suddenly summoned to $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$ and experiences combat in the $$ダンクーガノヴァ$$. When summoned again, he resolves to join in order to fill the emptiness in his heart that freedom alone could not satisfy.
The fact that he never seems to be short of money, along with glimpses of education in things like computers and flower arranging, hint at a part of the life he led before becoming homeless.
He is normally cool and detached, but in battle he often wants to shout out his catchphrase or welcomes his personal theme song, showing a hot-blooded, childish side as well.
Incidentally, after the combination he is troubled by having no role of his own, and asks $$セイミー$$ to develop a finishing move that would make use of the $$ノヴァライノス$$ as its trigger.
He grows close with $$イザベル$$, whom he met at a party held by $$イゴール・コンツェルン$$, providing her with information about the $$ダンクーガノヴァ$$, and after all the fighting was over, the two were seen standing side by side for a photo shoot in a bitterly cold locale.

373.DSCR:
A young man known in $$ジーハ村$$ as 'Digger $$シモン$$'.
As a boy he was timid and prone to keeping his worries bottled up inside, with digging holes as his only real talent. But using the Core Drill and $$ラガン$$ he happened to dig up, he drives off a Gunmen that appears in the village. Together with $$カミナ$$, whom he looks up to as an older brother figure, and $$ヨーコ$$, who fights the Beastmen, he bursts out onto the surface.
As the fighting continues, he meets countless companions and eventually forms $$大グレン団$$. Though he loses $$カミナ$$ immediately afterward, his encounter with $$ニア$$ gives him the chance to move past his grief. As the leader of $$大グレン団$$, he becomes its true center in every sense, and ultimately achieves the defeat of the $$螺旋王$$, $$ロージェノム$$.
Afterward, he turns $$テッペリン$$, the royal capital and former stronghold of the Beastmen, into $$カミナシティ$$, establishes a new government to guide humanity, and becomes its first Supreme Commander.
His duties as Supreme Commander mostly consist of handling everyday complaints, and he spends his days struggling with a job he is not used to.
He was living out peaceful if tedious days, but that peace collapses when a child is born to $$ダヤッカ$$ and $$キヨウ$$. Their daughter $$アンネ$$ turns out to be exactly the one millionth of the 'one million monkeys' $$ロージェノム$$ left behind in his dying words, and this triggers $$ニア$$'s awakening as a $$メッセンジャー$$ of the $$アンチスパイラル$$, activating the Human Extermination System. On top of that, he is held responsible for his own careless actions as Supreme Commander, and at one point is sentenced to death and imprisoned.
Amid the $$アンチスパイラル$$'s continued attacks, his comrades break him out of his cell. Together with his former archenemy $$ヴィラル$$, who had been imprisoned alongside him, he boards $$グレンラガン$$ and heads into a new battle to win $$ニア$$ back.
At great cost, he achieves victory over the $$アンチスパイラル$$ and gets $$ニア$$ back, but soon after must face an eternal parting from her. Afterward, he entrusts the Core Drill to $$ギミー$$ and sets off alone to parts unknown.

374.DSCR:
A Beastman, former commander of the Far East Division of the Anti-Human Suppression Force, a Beastman corps under $$チミルフ$$ of the $$螺旋王$$'s $$四天王$$.
He possesses great combat ability and a fierce temperament, but also has a side that values courtesy. He remains loyal not only to the late $$螺旋王$$ $$ロージェノム$$ and his superior officer $$チミルフ$$, but also to the rest of the $$四天王$$, and continues to pay them respect even now.
His contact with $$カミナ$$ in a past battle, and his defeat at his hands, mark a turning point that greatly changes his view of humans, whom he had previously seen only as prey to be hunted. Eventually, he learns that $$カミナ$$ died without his knowledge, and is further defeated, this time by $$シモン$$.
As a result of the question 'what exactly are humans?', $$ロージェノム$$, intrigued by such un-Beastman-like thinking, grants him an immortal body.
After the fall of $$テッペリン$$, he throws himself into anti-government guerrilla activity against the new government.
After his defeat as a guerrilla, he is imprisoned, but is unexpectedly reunited with $$シモン$$. When the Human Extermination System is activated, he joins forces with his former archenemy to try to stop it.
Being a Beastman, he does not possess $$螺旋力$$, but his outstanding skill at piloting Gunmen earns him a seat in $$グレン$$. Laughing wryly at his own strange fate, he succeeds in the 'Fated Combination' with $$シモン$$, and fights against the $$アンチスパイラル$$.

375.DSCR:
A sniper from $$リットナー村$$.
She has a realistic, level-headed side, but also an honest, cheerful, straightforward personality, and could be called the mood-maker of $$大グレン団$$ - though as the years passed, she grew into a woman with added composure and warmth.
She handles a sniper rifle bigger than she is with ease, and her marksmanship, which she confidently claimed was the best in the village, has not dulled in the slightest.
After the new government was established, feeling it was not her place, she left her comrades and traveled alone to $$コレハナ島$$, where she took the name $$ヨマコ$$ and became a teacher.
As the world faces a new crisis, she resolves to fight for the sake of the children and rejoins $$大グレン団$$. She rescues $$シモン$$ and $$ヴィラル$$ from their peril in prison, then heads out into space and fights against the $$アンチスパイラル$$.

proofread.reason: mistranslation: the Japanese says the shooting skill she herself claimed/believed was the village's best, not a source of pride for the village

376.DSCR:
The first princess of the $$螺旋王$$ $$ロージェノム$$.
During the battle against the $$螺旋王$$, she emerges from a container $$シモン$$ discovers, and joins $$大グレン団$$ as she is.
She is naive to an astonishing degree, with an extremely pure, easygoing personality. Moreover, as the enemy commander's daughter, the members of $$大グレン団$$, who had just lost $$カミナ$$, are at first cold toward her. But her charm and strength of will win over everyone's hearts, and she becomes something of an idol figure to the group. She has a particularly great influence on $$シモン$$'s growth.
During the decisive battle inside $$テッペリン$$, she rides along in $$ラガン$$ and fights alongside $$シモン$$. After witnessing her father $$ロージェノム$$'s defeat, she speaks of her resolve to move toward tomorrow.
Her cooking skill is so bizarre it traumatizes $$ロシウ$$. Only $$シモン$$ (and $$ブータ$$) seem to find it delicious, and that remains true even now.
Eventually she accepts $$シモン$$'s proposal, but at first, in a moment of obliviousness, turns him down. But after seriously reconsidering what it meant, she accepts. Just as the two seem destined to be joined together, however, the $$アンチスパイラル$$ factor dormant within her awakens, and she becomes a $$メッセンジャー$$.
After the battle against the $$アンチスパイラル$$, she holds a wedding ceremony with $$シモン$$, who saved her. Right after they exchange a kiss, because she is a virtual life form, she vanishes along with the fall of the $$アンチスパイラル$$. But her final moment is one of savoring her happiness, with a smile on her face.

proofread.reason: mistranslation: the Japanese says the members found her off-putting/shunned her, not merely 'wary'

377.DSCR:
A boy from $$アダイ村$$, the same village as $$ロシウ$$, and $$ダリー$$'s twin brother.
His parents passed away when he was very young. He and his sister meet $$シモン$$ and the others when they visit $$アダイ村$$, and continue on as members of $$大グレン団$$ all the way through to the final battle against the Beastmen.
After the new government is established, he becomes the pilot of a $$グラパール$$, eventually leading a unit while piloting his own personal-colored machine.
However, he has been full of energy to spare since childhood and is bad at sitting still. Having grown up constantly watching the adults of $$大グレン団$$ in action, he has made a fighting style that could charitably be called bold, or less charitably called reckless, into his personal creed. Because of this, the steady, careful $$ダリー$$ is always the one scolding him.
But he grows through the fighting against the $$アンチスパイラル$$, and in the final battle, he boards $$天元突破グラパール$$, formed by combining his and $$ダリー$$'s $$スペースグラパール$$s. Uniting their two hearts as one, he fights against the $$アンチスパイラル$$.
After driving off the $$アンチスパイラル$$, he is entrusted with the Core Drill by $$シモン$$, and in the epilogue becomes a pilot of $$グレンラガン$$ together with $$ダリー$$.

378.DSCR:
A girl from $$アダイ村$$, the same village as $$ロシウ$$, and $$ギミー$$'s twin sister.
Her parents passed away when she was very young. She and her brother meet $$シモン$$ and the others when they visit $$アダイ村$$, and continue on as members of $$大グレン団$$ all the way through to the final battle against the Beastmen.
After the new government is established, she becomes the pilot of a $$グラパール$$, eventually leading a unit while piloting her own personal-colored machine.
As a young child she was quiet and reserved, but as she grew in body she also grew in spirit, developing into a steady, dependable person. In battle as well, training hard to catch up to $$ヨーコ$$, whom she admired, she became the top marksman of the $$グラパール$$ unit.
She also served as a brake on the reckless, charging $$ギミー$$.
In the final battle against the $$アンチスパイラル$$, she boards $$天元突破グラパール$$, formed by combining her and $$ギミー$$'s $$スペースグラパール$$s, and fights hard so as not to be outdone by her seniors.
After driving off the $$アンチスパイラル$$, in the epilogue she becomes a pilot of $$グレンラガン$$ together with $$ギミー$$, who inherited the Core Drill.

379.DSCR:
A member of $$大グレン団$$ and head of the new government's Food Department.
He hails from $$リットナー村$$, formerly an underground armory, and though mild-mannered, was the village's leader, bravely facing the enemy in battle.
After joining $$大グレン団$$, he initially fights in his personal machine, the $$ダヤッカイザー$$, and later becomes acting captain of the $$ダイグレン$$. With his wealth of combat experience and leadership, he unites everyone and consistently serves as an emotional pillar for those around him.
After peace is won, he marries $$キヨウ$$, with whom he weathered fierce battles together. Blessed with children as well, his sense of responsibility and presence have only grown.
When setting off into space, he struggles with the conflict of leaving his family behind to go to war, but $$キヨウ$$ pushes him to firm up his resolve. In the final battle, he faces the $$アンチスパイラル$$ head-on with the attack 'My Wife Swings Better Than Anyone in the Universe', answering $$キヨウ$$'s feelings for him.

380.DSCR:
A member of $$大グレン団$$ and head of the new government's Science Department.
Like $$ヨーコ$$ and $$ダヤッカ$$, he hails from $$リットナー村$$, and stands out for his rather feminine mannerisms.
He possesses an unrivaled intellect and is skilled at analyzing information as well. He is also one of the rare few in $$大グレン団$$ who is able to read.
Devoted to research and brimming with curiosity, he becomes interested in $$ラガン$$ and resolves to accompany $$カミナ$$ and the others. It is in large part thanks to $$リーロン$$'s skill that multiple Gunmen were combined into $$グレン$$, and that the $$ダイガンザン$$ was remodeled into the $$ダイグレン$$, and he demonstrated his mechanical expertise in many other places besides.
Even after the new government was founded, he continued to play an active role shouldering intellectual labor of all kinds, from unraveling various systems to developing new weapons.

381.DSCR:
The $$螺旋王$$ $$ロージェノム$$, now a biological computer.
$$ロシウ$$ creates him from a fragment of $$ロージェノム$$'s cells in order to learn the truth behind the words $$ロージェノム$$ left as he lay dying.
He claims not to be the $$螺旋王$$ himself, but possesses knowledge and memories equal to those he held in life.
In the final battle against the $$アンチスパイラル$$, he reclaims his living form, and fights alongside $$シモン$$ and the others as a survivor of the Spiral Race's warriors.

382.DSCR:
A member of $$大グレン団$$ and of the new government's Science Department.
A hasty, restless trigger-happy sort, he formerly served as the gunner of the $$ダイグレン$$, and often mashed the fire button repeatedly.
His words and actions never change, in battle or in daily life, and even as the years pass, neither his appearance nor his character has changed one bit. But in the final battle against the $$アンチスパイラル$$, he declared 'Blurry shots, time lag - that's my specialty', and fired off a probability-shifting round that nullified the enemy's defensive odds.

383.DSCR:
A member of the new government's Science Department.
A patient man who sees any hardship through to the end no matter the odds, he previously served as the helmsman of the $$ダイグレン$$.
When the members of $$大グレン団$$ departed for space, he once again took the helm of the $$アークグレン$$, and later of the $$超銀河ダイグレン$$ as well.

385.DSCR:
Deputy Supreme Commander of the New Government.
He met $$シモン$$ and the others when they passed through $$アダイ村$$ on their journey, and joined $$グレン団$$.
Raised by the strict Priest $$マギン$$, he grew up smart and earnest. Always calm and able to see the big picture, he was a rare voice of common sense amid the chaotic, unruly $$大グレン団$$, and often gave advice to $$シモン$$ and the others.
After $$カミナ$$'s death, he supported $$シモン$$ as the pilot of $$グレン$$, and had more than enough spirit to earn his place in $$大グレン団$$.
These qualities have only sharpened with time, and since Supreme Commander $$シモン$$ has little head for politics, $$ロシウ$$ now single-handedly manages the New Government's day-to-day affairs.
When the Human Extermination System activated, he made the agonizing decision to place the blame on $$シモン$$ in order to quell the public's unrest. As a leader, he tried every means to keep humanity alive, even reviving his former enemy $$ロージェノム$$ as a bio-computer and attempting to escape Earth aboard the excavated $$アークグレン$$.
When he eventually realized the path he had taken was wrong, he tried to take his own life to atone. But $$シモン$$ and $$キノン$$ rushed to his side and talked him out of it. He saw $$シモン$$ and the others off as they departed for the final battle against the $$アンチスパイラル$$, and after the fighting ended and $$シモン$$ vanished, he continued as a leader, devoting the rest of his life to the advancement of humanity.

386.DSCR:
An operator in the New Government's Defense Operations Room.
Like $$ギンブレー$$ and others, she belongs to a younger generation than the members of $$大グレン団$$ who fought in the war against the $$螺旋王$$.
Her skill in accurately directing operations against the movements of the $$ムガン$$ that appeared in $$カミナシティ$$ was recognized, and she was entrusted with operator duties aboard both the $$アークグレン$$ and the $$超銀河ダイグレン$$.

proofread.reason: mistranslation: the Japanese says the Mugann's actions/movements (koudou), not 'the appearance'

388.DSCR:
The eldest daughter of the '$$黒の兄弟$$.' Her maiden name was $$バチカ$$.
She met $$シモン$$ and the others while working as a Beastman hunter. After joining $$大グレン団$$, she became a gunner on the $$ダイグレン$$'s third bridge alongside $$キヤル$$, and later piloted the $$ダヤッカイザー$$. She also had a talent for hand-to-hand combat, and once held her own against a Beastman unarmed.
Cheerful and nurturing, she was more of a mother figure to her siblings than simply the eldest sister.
She initially had a crush on $$カミナ$$, but after the war against the $$螺旋王$$ ended, she married $$ダヤッカ$$. In time, she gave birth to their daughter, $$アンネ$$, the fruit of their love.
When $$大グレン団$$ set off for the final battle against the $$アンチスパイラル$$, she saw her husband $$ダヤッカ$$ off with a smile.

390.DSCR:
The indomitable, ferocious leader of $$グレン団$$.
An overwhelmingly forceful man, he powers through anything with sheer spirit and momentum, kicking reason aside to make the impossible happen.
His recklessness was legendary: he once faced down a Gunmen armed with nothing but a sword. He went on to steal a Gunmen bare-handed and pilot it on the spot, and drove $$ラガン$$ into $$グレン$$'s head to declare a 'combination,' then made it a reality, displaying his free-spirited, wild nature at every turn.
Yet his fighting spirit, force of will, and conviction to see anything through gave him tremendous charisma. When he left $$ジーハ村$$, his only companions were $$シモン$$ and $$ヨーコ$$, but he drew in everyone he met, eventually building $$大グレン団$$ into a great force.
He and $$ヨーコ$$, both strong-willed, never stopped bickering over trivial things. Still, they cared for each other, and before the decisive battle against $$チミルフ$$ they opened their hearts and shared a kiss. He boasted, 'I'll pay you back tenfold when I get back,' but a mistake by $$シモン$$ during the battle proved the trigger for a fatal wound. With his last ounce of strength he scolded $$シモン$$ and passed his soul on to him, then burned away to pure white.
Both his way of living and his way of dying left their mark on countless people, and even on the Beastmen.
A statue of $$カミナ$$ stands in the city of '$$カミナシティ$$,' built on the site of $$テッペリン$$.
When $$大グレン団$$ was trapped in the multiverse labyrinth by the $$アンチスパイラル$$, he appeared before $$シモン$$ and $$ヨーコ$$ and gave each of them the push they needed.

391.DSCR:
A pig-mole who is both $$シモン$$'s pet and his best friend.
Small but energetic, he usually rides on $$シモン$$'s shoulder, though he has also been spotted burrowing into $$ヨーコ$$'s cleavage.
His tail grows back after being cut off, making him a reliable emergency ration as well. He is said to be quite delicious and highly nutritious, and once revived $$シモン$$ and $$カミナ$$ in an instant when hunger left them unable to fight properly.

His body is also a mass of $$螺旋力$$, and by releasing his stored $$螺旋力$$ as Spiral Energy, he proved himself a true member of $$大グレン団$$.

392.DSCR:
The 'Third Child,' who pilots $$エヴァンゲリオン初号機$$. Age 14.
Summoned by $$ＮＥＲＶ$$, the special agency headed by his father $$ゲンドウ$$ as Supreme Commander, he boards the all-purpose humanoid decisive weapon, the artificial human Evangelion, and fights the Angels with the fate of the world at stake.
From then on he lives with $$ミサト$$ at her apartment and attends $$第３新東京市$$ Municipal Junior High School No. 1.
At first, his introverted nature, low self-esteem, and status as an EVA pilot leave him isolated as a new transfer student, and he clashes with classmates like $$トウジ$$. But through the battles against the Angels, he opens his heart to them and builds real friendships. Guided and encouraged by $$ミサト$$ in her role as guardian, and through his interactions with the First Child $$レイ#pt394$$ and the Second Child $$アスカ$$, he slowly grows as a person.
He initially hates piloting EVA and clashes with $$ゲンドウ$$ over it, but as he matures, his feelings on the matter begin to change. However, the appearance of $$第９の使徒$$ becomes the catalyst for their relationship deteriorating beyond repair, and $$シンジ$$ decides to quit piloting EVA.

393.DSCR:
The 'Third Child,' who pilots $$エヴァンゲリオン初号機$$.
After the battle against $$第１０の使徒$$, he is recovered by the anti-$$ＮＥＲＶ$$ organization '$$ＷＩＬＬＥ$$' and reunited with his former comrades such as $$ミサト$$, but they are all uniformly cold to him.

394.DSCR:
The 'First Child,' who pilots $$エヴァンゲリオン零号機$$.
She attends $$第３新東京市$$ Municipal Junior High School No. 1, in the same class as $$シンジ$$, Year 2 Class A.
A quiet girl who shows almost no emotion, much about her past remains a mystery. The one person she opens her heart to is $$ゲンドウ$$, with whom she converses with a smile and shares meals.
But through the battles, she gradually begins to change, showing emotion to $$シンジ$$ and $$アスカ$$. After finding the miso soup $$シンジ$$ made delicious, she starts practicing cooking so she can host a meal for the Ikari father and son.
However, all of this comes to nothing with the appearance of $$第９の使徒$$.

pilot 350 DSC2: 'the AS mock cavalry battle at the base' for 駐屯地でのＡＳ騎馬戦, matching 'mock cavalry battle' in pilot 358.
pilot 359: 中尉 is 'lieutenant'; first lieutenant is also possible. The DSCR gives no pronoun for Sachs, so the rank sentence is a fragment; 'it' refers to the AI Al.
pilot 363: サクヤ (reading of the given name) is a new token with English Sakuya because the Japanese is katakana, not 朔哉.

pilot 373-395: 大グレン団 is proposed as Team Dai-Gurren and グレン団 as Team Gurren (Jigoku mixed Dai-Gurren Brigade / Team Dai-Gurren). ジーハ村 as Giha Village (Jigoku had both Jiha and Giha). チミルフ as Chimyulf (Jigoku had Chimiruf and Chimyulf). All Jigoku prose was re-tokenized accordingly.

pilot 374: Jigoku's 'the Spiral King's $$フォウ$$ Heavenly Kings general' was a mistokenization of 四天王 (Four Heavenly Kings); replaced by the new token 四天王 = Four Heavenly Kings. The 元 of 元螺旋王四天王 is ambiguous (former commander vs former Four Heavenly Kings); I kept Jigoku's 'former commander'. The second paragraph is new in Tengoku (not only Lordgenome and Chimyulf but also the other Four Heavenly Kings) and was translated fresh. Jigoku's 'Anti-Human Suppression Force' for 人間掃討軍 kept.
pilot 375: Jigoku DSC2 had 'and fought against the Anti-Spiral' after present tense verbs; changed to present 'fights' for tense agreement.
pilot 377/378: the twins combine their Space Grapearls (スペースグラパール) per the Japanese; Jigoku wrote only 'Grapearls', so the token スペースグラパール is used, with the plural s outside.
pilot 382: Jigoku's 'neither his appearance nor his character have changed' corrected to 'has'; new clause 'often mashed the fire button repeatedly' translates 発射ボタンを連打していた.
pilot 383: Jigoku's first line 'A science bureau official of the New Government' was changed to 'A member of the new government's Science Department' to agree with pilot 382 (both are 科学局員).
pilot 385: the Tengoku Japanese splits the arrival at Adai Village and the upbringing by Priest Magin into two paragraphs; followed Tengoku's paragraphing (Jigoku had one paragraph).

pilot 386: Jigoku's 'Mugannn's appearance' (token plus stray letters) replaced by 'the appearance of the $$ムガン$$'; the Jigoku wording 'tracked and directed the response' for オペレートした is loose but kept.
pilot 390: new sentence about the Kamina statue in Kamina City (absent from Jigoku) translated fresh. 多元宇宙迷宮 is rendered 'multiverse labyrinth' (Jigoku had only 'multiverse').

pilot 392: Jigoku's DSC2 ending is replaced by a fuller translation because the Tengoku DSCR now says Shinji decides to quit EVA, and the DSC2 ending names Rei absorbed by the 10th Angel. $$レイ#pt394$$ is used for the First Child (same character as pilot 394). The glossary English for 第１０の使徒 is '10th Angel' while 第９の使徒 is 'the Ninth Angel'; tokens kept.
pilot 393: エヴァＭａｒｋ．０９ is written with the glossary token エヴァンゲリオンＭａｒｋ．０９ (no space form) and in 395 with エヴァンゲリオン　Ｍａｒｋ．０９ (fullwidth-space form); both are Evangelion Mark.09.
pilot 394: dropped Jigoku's 'for her' in 'the miso soup Shinji made for her' (the Japanese only says the miso soup Shinji made).
pilot 395: 綾波レイならどうする？ is rendered 'What would Rei Ayanami do?' with the 綾波レイ token.
